task.body:
## Problem
`normalize_scientific_name` (`app/species_dossier/service.py`) matches the rank marker case-insensitively but emits it as typed, so equivalent names normalise differently before `repository.resolve_name`: `Cattleya labiata VAR. alba` stays `Cattleya labiata VAR. alba`, and the URL slug `Cattleya_labiata_Var._alba` gives `Cattleya labiata Var. alba`. Botanical rank abbreviations are written in lower case.

## Required behaviour
- Emit the rank marker lower-cased.
- `normalize_scientific_name("Cattleya labiata VAR. alba") == "Cattleya labiata var. alba"`.
- `normalize_scientific_name("cattleya labiata Subsp. alba") == "Cattleya labiata subsp. alba"`.
- `normalize_scientific_name("Cattleya labiata F. alba") == "Cattleya labiata f. alba"`.
- `extract_species_name_from_url("https://partner.example/species/Cattleya_labiata_Var._alba") == "Cattleya labiata var. alba"`.
- Nothing else changes (genus capitalisation, epithets, existing tests).

## Scope
Allowed paths:
- `app/species_dossier/service.py`
- `tests/test_species_dossier_service.py`

Do not change any other file. Existing tests must keep passing unchanged; add new tests only to the test file above.

## Validation
- `python -m pytest -q tests/test_species_dossier_service.py tests/test_species_dossier_routes.py`
- `python -m ruff check app/species_dossier/service.py tests/test_species_dossier_service.py`

New tests must cover:
- upper-case and title-case `var.`, `subsp.` and `f.` inputs;
- the URL-slug case.

OC-SWARM-WRITES: repo-global
